subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector, and what shared auth-profile picker contract should Discord, Telegram, and other channel UIs implement?
rationale: Current source supports typed profile pinning, but the requested UI changes how users see and persist auth-profile state across channels and provider routes.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile selection model that channel pickers consume, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed profile commands
options.body: Document `/model ...@profile` and `/model status` as the supported account-switching flow and do not add picker account controls.

options.title: Pilot one channel
options.body: Approve a narrow Discord or Telegram experiment while explicitly deferring cross-channel parity until the shared contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile selection model that channel pickers consume, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans provider identity, shared `/models` browse behavior, and session/gateway model override paths.
